note: The pre-authentication screens (IAM-010g, FR-ONB-000). These are the only strings in the catalogue a person can read before any account exists, which makes them the ones most likely to be read by somebody who cannot read the other language — the whole reason §20 puts a language control here.

auth.sign_in.heading.note: 'Inloggen', not 'Aanmelden'. Dutch 'aanmelden' means both 'sign in' and 'register', so on a screen whose other option is creating an account it is exactly the wrong word — the two choices would read as the same one.

auth.screen_label.note: Accessible name for the pre-authentication region, so a screen-reader user landing here is told what this screen is before its controls.
auth.screen_label.en: Sign in or create an account

auth.language.hint.note: IAM-010g's behaviour, said out loud: 'The choice persists on the device and is applied to the account after first login.' Worth stating rather than leaving to be discovered — somebody choosing a language before they have an account has no way to know whether it will survive, and on a shared machine has a reason to care.
auth.language.hint.nl: Uw taalkeuze wordt op dit apparaat onthouden en na uw eerste aanmelding aan uw account toegevoegd.
auth.language.hint.en: Your language choice is remembered on this device and added to your account after you first sign in.

auth.sign_out.note: The authenticated shell's header (App.tsx). ADR-054 shipped the endpoint (`POST /v1/auth/logout`); this is its one caller.

auth.mfa.heading.note: ADR-054's MFA enrolment screen, shown after a password/Google sign-in that has not yet cleared IAM-011's gate. Not 'Sign in' or 'Create an account' - the person is already authenticated, this is the one remaining step.

auth.sign_in.or.note: Divider between the password form and the Google/passkey buttons.

auth.sign_in.switch_to_signup.en: Don't have an account? Create one

auth.sign_up.account_model.label.note: FR-MDL-001's one question: own business, or clients. Read before the rest of the form because it decides which of the two remaining fields (KvK number) appears.
auth.sign_up.account_model.label.en: What will you use LEDGR for?

auth.sign_up.account_model.firm.nl: De boekhouding van klanten, als accountantskantoor
auth.sign_up.account_model.firm.en: My clients' books, as an accounting firm

auth.sign_up.switch_to_login.nl: Heeft u al een account? Inloggen
auth.sign_up.switch_to_login.en: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.mfa.intro.note: Explains WHY this screen exists, the moment it is met - IAM-011 with no opt-out, right after the account that was just created. Naming the requirement plainly is deliberate: a person told nothing would read this as a broken redirect.
auth.mfa.intro.nl: LEDGR vereist een tweede inlogstap voor elk account. Stel er hieronder één in om verder te gaan.
auth.mfa.intro.en: LEDGR requires a second sign-in step for every account. Set one up below to continue.

auth.mfa.totp.instructions.nl: Scan deze code met een authenticator-app (zoals Google Authenticator of 1Password) of voer de sleutel handmatig in.
auth.mfa.totp.instructions.en: Scan this with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or 1Password), or enter the key manually.

auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.note: Step-up path: this browser already has an enrolled TOTP factor from a prior session (mfa.enrollment.hasTotp), so the screen asks for a code rather than offering to enrol a new one.
auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.nl: Voer een code uit uw authenticator-app in
auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.en: Enter a code from your authenticator app

auth.mfa.passkey.heading.note: 'Passkey' has no established separate Dutch term in this domain - Dutch-language security/authentication documentation (including Google's and Apple's own Dutch UI) uses the English word as-is.

auth.mfa.unavailable.note: navigator.credentials is absent - an old browser, or a non-secure context. Shown instead of the passkey button rather than a button that would fail on click.
auth.mfa.unavailable.nl: Passkeys worden niet ondersteund in deze browser.
auth.mfa.unavailable.en: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.

auth.google.callback.failed.nl: Inloggen met Google is mislukt. Probeer het opnieuw.
auth.google.callback.failed.en: Signing in with Google failed. Please try again.

auth.google.callback.link_required.note: IAM-010c: this Google identity is not yet linked to an existing account. ADR-054 does not wire the follow-up endpoint that would let this screen collect a password and complete the link (GoogleSignInService.confirm_link_with_password exists server-side, no route calls it yet) - named honestly rather than left to look like a stuck screen.
auth.google.callback.link_required.nl: Dit Google-account is nog niet gekoppeld aan een LEDGR-account. Log in met uw wachtwoord om te koppelen.
auth.google.callback.link_required.en: This Google account is not yet linked to a LEDGR account. Sign in with your password to link it.
